evidence: the ability to keep pace with technological changes, including changes regarding cybersecurity and artificial intelligence
The financial services industry continues to undergo rapid technological changes, including the development and use of artificial intelligence ("AI")
New and evolving AI use, including generative AI, may make us susceptible to uncertain risks and may require additional investment to develop responsible use frameworks
Many of our competitors have substantially greater resources to invest in technological improvements
We may not be able to effectively implement new technology-driven products and services or be successful in marketing these products and services to our clients
ai_positioning.summary: HOMB adopte une posture défensive face à l'IA, exprimant des préoccupations sur sa capacité à suivre le rythme technologique et les risques associés à l'IA générative, sans démontrer d'initiatives propres de développement ou d'intégration IA.
